content.short: Anastasia Labs is a Cardano smart contract audit and development company building secure tools and open-source infrastructure.
content.description: Anastasia Labs is a Cardano smart contract audit and development company focused on safe, efficient on-chain systems. The team combines backgrounds in blockchain engineering, computer science, cybersecurity, and business operations to help projects design and review smart contracts. Its services include audits, consulting, and bespoke development for teams building with Cardano and related technologies. Anastasia Labs also contributes open-source infrastructure that supports builders in the ecosystem.
content.meta: Anastasia Labs provides Cardano smart contract audits, development support, and secure open-source infrastructure. Explore it on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
